Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued
The maintenance staff should be 
 trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding work area is required.
Wear the safety and healthy 
 equipment.
The unit must be on service.
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool set
Safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 breathing mask, safety glass ... etc
Digital voltmeter and clamp 
 ammeter.
New brushes.
Useful brush length.
Work to be Carried Out
Check the brush vibration.
Check the sparking brushes.
Check brush holders.
Replace the brush by a new one if its not fall below 6A/cm2 
 (=60A per brush) and not exceed 12A/cm2 (=120A per brush).
Record current and voltage value of generator as in MRDS and 
 compare the results with the standard value fig (1).
